summary: T4 round-3 rework for R1 and R2 (reviewed target agent/integration@b71f52e), plus the R2 round-4 follow-up. Restored the Iced mode-selector strip inset (4) and routed its segments through theme::MODE_PADDING, restored the mixer handle's hover swell (Iced accent_slider maps Hovered|Dragged to 8.0), moved the Random Mix ratio group to GROUP_PADDING (14), swapped the mixer rail to the Iced split (PRIMARY_TEXT left of the handle, RELEASE_TEXT right), and moved the two-handle duration rail to the Iced widgets::RangeSlider geometry (12px rail/radius 6, constant 16px thumbs). Each fix is pinned by a rendered regression test that fails when the fix is reverted. The earlier report's claim that the mode-selector call site already used Margin::same(4) was incorrect: the margin was absent from the integrated tree, and is corrected here. Round-4 follow-up: the rate_group row-2 inline comment, which still described the pre-round rail ('RELEASE_TEXT filled rail'), was corrected to the split-rail contract.

The padding, rail-colour and geometry fixes are layout claims the automated suite measures through painted shape geometry and AccessKit rects; it does not render pixels or compare against the web reference.

The Iced source (src/ui/ and the pinned iced rev f8127c8) is the behaviour specification for this port. If the locally unavailable web reference shows different slider colouring or geometry, the Master should arbitrate and record the deviation in docs/architecture/ui.md.

The mixer handle swells when the pointer is anywhere inside the slider's full-width hit rect (the port allocates the row's full width), matching iced's is_over(layout.bounds()) rather than proximity to the handle is not reproduced pixel-exactly; the Iced bounds are also the full widget bounds, so the rule matches, but the drawn rail is inset 8px from that rect on each side.
